free_text: The decision to defer biopsy is supported by the explicit cohort criterion, which matched the reading urologist in 16 of 18 cases with a PI-RADS 3 finding following a prior negative biopsy. This is weighed against the PI-RADS 3 score and the prior negative biopsy status, which are the most relevant factors. The evidence converged on deferral because the protocol prioritized the cohort rule over conflicting expert suggestions.
